title: Maa Lakshmi ka Prakatya
playlist: Maa Durga aur Devi ki Kathayein
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Sage Durvasa with matted hair and saffron robes, eyes blazing with anger, raising his hand in a curse in front of a grand heavenly palace, Lord Indra on a white elephant Airavat with a fallen flower garland on the ground, dramatic golden clouds
scenes.tts: ऋषि दुर्वासा की माला का अपमान हुआ, तो उन्होंने इंद्र को श्राप दे दिया।
scenes.sub: Rishi Durvasa ki mala ka apmaan hua, to unhone Indra ko shraap de diya.

scenes.prompt: Lord Vishnu, blue-skinned with a crown, conch, discus, mace and lotus, resting on the serpent Shesha in the cosmic ocean, calmly guiding the gods who stand with folded hands before him
scenes.tts: भगवान विष्णु ने देवताओं को असुरों के साथ मिलकर समुद्र मंथन की सलाह दी।
scenes.sub: Bhagwan Vishnu ne devtaon ko asuron ke saath milkar Samudra Manthan ki salah di.

scenes.prompt: Gods and demons churning the vast ocean using Mount Mandara as the churning rod and the serpent Vasuki as the rope, Lord Vishnu as a giant tortoise Kurma supporting the mountain below, waves and golden spray
scenes.tts: मंदराचल पर्वत मथानी बना और वासुकि नाग रस्सी। मंथन बरसों चला।
scenes.sub: Mandarachal parvat mathani bana aur Vasuki naag rassi. Manthan barson chala.

scenes.prompt: Goddess Lakshmi rising from the ocean waves, seated on a pink lotus, golden skin, red and gold saree, jewelled crown, two elephants pouring water on her from golden pots, radiant divine glow, gods watching in awe
scenes.tts: तभी लहरों से कमल पर विराजमान माँ लक्ष्मी प्रकट हुईं।
scenes.sub: Tabhi lehron se kamal par virajmaan Maa Lakshmi prakat huin.

scenes.prompt: Goddess Lakshmi gently placing a lotus garland around Lord Vishnu's neck, both smiling, soft golden light, lotus petals falling, gods showering flowers from above
scenes.tts: माँ लक्ष्मी ने विष्णु जी को वरमाला पहनाई। श्री फिर स्वर्ग लौट आई।
scenes.sub: Maa Lakshmi ne Vishnu ji ko varmala pehnayi. Shree phir Swarg laut aayi.

scenes.tts: ॐ महालक्ष्म्यै नमः। कथा पसंद आए तो लाइक, शेयर और श्याम प्रेमी एसएन को सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Om Mahalakshmyai Namah. Katha pasand aaye to Like, Share aur Shyam Premi SN ko Subscribe karein.
